name: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Branden
visible.title: Get this if you have the turbo Max engine
visible.body: Easy install less than an hour with some good tools and don't worry about air filter life issuing warnings on dash just look into the owners manual under vehicle care it explains how to disable the whole thing in the dash settings
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: angel
visible.title: Love it
visible.body: Truck feels like is breathing, moves as soon you press the gas.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Devin
visible.title: Does what it says it will do.
visible.body: Easy to install, a little struggle getting the OEM airbox out, bit not terrible. Definitely see an increase in power and pedal response. MPG gains of about 2.5-3mpg. It took about 3 days of driving for the system to fully adjust and see these kinds of numbers, so dont expect it instantly. Same exact daily route, same driving habits. A little over priced, but good product.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Mark
visible.title: Freed up a ton of space in engine compartment.
visible.body: Took me longer than it should have but I'm a weekend warrior. Looks great and time will tell on the performance end.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Bleu
visible.title: AFE CAI
visible.body: Frees up space under the hood, adds a small power boost, and the fit was flawless.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: CBS2024ChevyTB
visible.title: 2024 Chevy Silverado LT Trail Boss
visible.body: While this AFE CAI is doing awesome I did have some issues with the installation instructions. Had to go on youtube and found another chevy owner who installed a different CAI on his truck but his walk through made it so much simpler. Process to buy the CAI from AT was very simple and arrived 3 days later.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: AFEMomentumGT
visible.title: AFE GT cold air intake
visible.body: The item is great improvements include throttle response sound and 2 mpg gained. I highly recommend this product.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Avirts
visible.title: 2023 Custom
visible.body: Made huge difference wasn't to bad to install. Arrived really quick.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: steezyC13
visible.title: Good CAI
visible.body: Pretty nice cold air intake. The quality of the plastic could be a little more durable, seems kinda flimsy, but the ease of installation was topnotch. It improved the sound of my truck by a lot with the exhaust I put on. The check engine light did come on after installation on my Chevy, said there was a purge valve issue.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Dbennett1188
visible.title: Install
visible.body: Getting the old intake out was a pain but this just slipped right in. About 45 minutes of work all together.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: FRad58
visible.title: Awesome cold air intake!
visible.body: I ordered the intake and it arrived very quickly and I used the installation service offered on the site. Within 4 days the part arrived and it was also installed.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Philbrt
visible.title: AFE Momentum GT cold air intake
visible.body: Easy to follow instructions and gained 30 more miles per tank.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: CurtsTurbo
visible.title: Great intake
visible.body: I am very comfortable working on classic cars and this was my for my 21 silverado 2.7l turbo. So I took my time. Saw people say it takes around an hour to install. It took me 2hrs but I wanted to make sure I didn't screw it up lol. Fit is flawless and my TURBO LOVES IT. I haven't taken it on a long run yet only about 15 miles but I'm glad I invested in this.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Adamaleski
visible.title: Cold air intake
visible.body: Fit perfectly and directions were very helpful. Only took a few hrs and I'm not super handy when it comes to anything auto.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: JediMasterRisk
visible.title: Awesome Fit
visible.body: AT was very helpful in getting the original Airaid intake I purchased back and replaced it with the AFE intake. Then a set back but luckily with the help of AFE’s tech support they got me a replacement tube right away. (Nothing beats being in the same city as your work with the manufacture).
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Waderrrr
visible.title: Great product
visible.body: Great product, easy install. Turbo sounds a bit better.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Silla27
visible.title: Best CAI ever A+++
visible.body: Better acceleration, great sound, looks real nice!!!!!
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Tbush
visible.title: Great product a+++
visible.body: I put this on my 2021 Silverado an I must say a true difference in acceleration with the added sound to the 2.7 which is nice also. Haven’t had it on long to tell a difference in gas mileage but I’m sure with AFE u can’t go wrong. Easy to install with basic hand tools only took me 30min. A real great product everything is still organized like original down to the wire harness an engine cover. Not just thrown in like others. Very well pleased
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Eddiepo
visible.title: Afe fan for life
visible.body: Love this air Intake it was an easy install , I can tell the difference not crazy but just enough.....
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Femur77
visible.title: Great Intake
visible.body: Just installed this intake on my 2.7 turbo and I’m really impressed. Instructions were great and install went smoothly. I was pleasantly surprised that unlike the one I had on my 5.3 this one isn’t overly loud. Has helped my fuel mileage slightly and definitely has more power.
visible.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

low.author: steezyC13
low.title: Good CAI
low.body: Pretty nice cold air intake. The quality of the plastic could be a little more durable, seems kinda flimsy, but the ease of installation was topnotch. It improved the sound of my truck by a lot with the exhaust I put on. The check engine light did come on after installation on my Chevy, said there was a purge valve issue.
low.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (19-26 2.7L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: dannyff
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Not CARB EO compliant for 2017 and up silverados
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Not CARB EO compliant for 2017 and up silverados And now i cant get my truck smogged without having to purchase a stock intake system or a new CARB EO certified intake.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (14-18 6.2L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Jacob
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Missing parts
low_same_part_other_truck.body: The first thing in the instructions is to take a grommet from the factory air intake and install it on this $500 air intake. This $500 air intake does not come with the stupid factory grommet and I bought my car with a knm air intake and don’t have the stock air intake. Now I can’t install the $500 air intake because I don’t have a stupid grommet.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (11-23 6.4L HEMI Challenger w/o Shaker Hood)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Alec
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Does not fit 2025+
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I ordered this intake for my 2025 2.3L Ranger. The engine is built different than the 2024 so the turbo has a flat face with nothing for the rubber coupling at the end to slide on to. BE AWARE IF YOU HAVE A 2025+ THIS WILL NOT FIT
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (2024 2.3L EcoBoost Ranger)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: David H
low_same_part_other_truck.title: the intake looks great but the sound drowns out ra
low_same_part_other_truck.body: liked the product and installation, looks awsome installed dislike the sound when engine is under load you can't hear radio ITS AWFul loud removed and reinstalled factory intake system
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (18-26 3.6L Jeep Wrangler JL)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Marinewolf727
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Needs tune
low_same_part_other_truck.body: On your site, it say this product doesn’t need a tune. It immediately brought up my check engine light.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (18-23 2.0L Jeep Wrangler JL)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: SirVincent
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Poor engineering
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I had one until I went off road and the motor and frame moved more than this cai was designed for, the factory cai is designed for this normal flex, just ask your self how will this flex? It’s not designed to flex, the motor mounts on every vehicle are designed to flex, afe didn’t want to refund me either, the off road shop refunded me, I think they took the hit, if you don’t go off road you probably won’t have an issue, i really love the sound this gives over the stock intake, unfortunately I had to go back to the stock cold air intake, yes the factory intake on all new vehicles are cold air intakes, the only advantage this gives is no baffles and a slightly larger intake tube, I can’t believe afe is still selling this! Was it engineered in china?
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (14-18 5.3L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Patrick
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Mediocre at best
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I have not noticed even the slightest difference in performance after installing this intake. Let's face it. The 6.6 Gas motor is a pig. Im pretty certain there is nothing you can do to make it perform better.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (20-26 6.6L Gas Silverado 2500 HD)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Josh Glassman
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Missing part and bad fitment
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Right from the start I was missing the rubber boot at the entrance of the filter box. There is not spot for the MAF wire to mount on the intake tube right before the sensor. The resonator box off of the tube just sits on top of the old mount not secured in anyway. The 90 degree rubber boot that attaches to the throttle body is very flimsy. Very disappointed for the price.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (23-26 6.8L F-250 Super Duty)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Joe
low_same_part_other_truck.title: No Access Lid
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Seems like a good CAI, definitely brought my temps down but there's no access to change to filter have to take the tube off to do so.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (14-18 5.3L Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Lazaro
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Disappointed
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I heard 0 changes and actually I’m quite disappointed that this $400 upgrade didn’t make any changes even power wise and I just don’t want to have to go on a mission to take it back but it really is quite unfortunate because it’s a pretty nice intake.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (21-26 3.5L PowerBoost F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: DaveGreg
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Performance
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Notice only a little bit of throttle response and as for sound, no difference.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (15-26 2.7L EcoBoost F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Chase
low_same_part_other_truck.title: AFE Cold Air intake
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I haven't noticed anything, still sounds the same and still feels the same. No gas mileage increase or anything, kind of a let down for an intake that cost $400 plus.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Momentum GT Cold Air Intake with Pro DRY S Filter; Black (23-26 Colorado)
